title: Biophysical Approaches for Investigating the Dynamics and Cooperativity of Ternary Complexes in Targeted Protein Degradation.
authors: Shcherbakov, Alexander A; Poppe, Leszek; Vaish, Amit
one_liner_zh: 该文研究靶向蛋白降解三元复合物的生物物理方法，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Heterobifunctional small molecules (hSMs) are a rapidly emerging therapeutic modality that induces spatial proximity between biomolecules, such as proteins, by forming a ternary complex. In this study, we introduce biophysical methodologies to study ternary complexes involving hydrodynamic profiling by nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (HAP-NMR) and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC). These approaches allowed us to evaluate the hydrodynamic and thermodynamic factors that influence molecular dynamics and ternary complex formation in solution. We addressed challenges like the limited solubility of hSMs, particularly in ITC experiments, and the near-ideal equimolar stoichiometry (1:1:1) of the ternary complex in solution, which is necessary for accurate hydrodynamic parameter evaluation. Our methodology facilitated the characterization of a known degrader of SMARCA proteins and revealed subtle higher-level structural differences. This approach provided insights into the overall behavior and function of the SMARCA2 and SMARCA4 protein ternary complexes.
abstract_zh: 异双功能小分子（hSMs）是一种快速兴起的新型治疗模式，通过形成三元复合物诱导生物分子（如蛋白质）之间的空间邻近。在本研究中，我们引入了生物物理方法，结合核磁共振波谱流体动力学剖面分析（HAP-NMR）和等温滴定量热法（ITC）来研究三元复合物。这些方法使我们能够评估影响溶液中分子动力学和三元复合物形成的流体动力学及热力学因素。我们解决了诸如hSMs溶解度有限（尤其在ITC实验中）以及溶液中三元复合物接近理想的等摩尔化学计量比（1:1:1）等挑战，后者对于准确的流体动力学参数评估是必需的。我们的方法促进了对已知SMARCA蛋白降解剂的表征，并揭示了细微的高层级结构差异。该方法为SMARCA2和SMARCA4蛋白三元复合物的整体行为和功能提供了见解。
